For the two leaving-front cases, distinguish a missing lawful lateral branch from a longitudinal speed error. Candidate alternatives must be based on current topology and declared intent priors, not chosen using the observed destination.
For the two focal-overadvance cases, retain the declared residual domain and distinguish a feasible motion/action branch from the zero-residual point mask.

A feasible branch or union of branches establishes feasibility only. Specify normalized weights and the parameter/gradient dependence before calling it a likelihood or claiming that fitting can resume.

deliverable: A bounded mathematical conditioning/order definition, exact-case feasible/unresolved evidence and a decision about whether a tractable shared objective can be implemented. Do not modify the production forward operator before that definition is concrete.
after: If a coherent shared formulation exists, separately define its full frozen-record comparison and fitting budget. Preserve the old iteration-limit HOLD. No automatic optimization, calibration or rollout.

For each intent enumerate r_j in {0,-b_j}; fresh resolver for every tuple; every selected actor enumerates all post-longitudinal topology/goal legal sides and stay. execution_check: Check all included joint landing gaps; separately check forced desired actions in the frozen production packet order using its goal/gap/body rules. Outside lateral actions stay as an intervention.
evidence_limits: Residual endpoints are external interventions, not samples from the190-coefficient model or proof of shared-beta realizability. Endpoint geometry and order witnesses do not establish native subsecond trajectories. No probabilities assigned to the residual endpoint atoms.
conditional_lc_probability: For every fixed intent and external residual tuple separately, enumerate the whole static-goal lawful LC tuple set and evaluate original sequential dynamic masks. Lane logits are fixed at0; each allowed desired action has factor1/|A_t|, illegal tuples mass0. Verify total LC mass1, report per-class marginal and endpoint-F mass separately. Never average over residual tuples or infer a residual probability law. Background lateral actions are do(stay), nonfocal intents are the fixed current prior draw.
